name: SALMONN: Towards Generic Hearing Abilities for Large Language Models
problem: LLMs are text-only; cascaded ASR pipelines lose paralinguistic information and cannot handle music or audio events.
mechanism: Whisper-based encoder plus a Whisper/HuBERT audio feature stack projected into the LLM embedding space, with Q-Former-style Perceiver resampler blocks compressing variable-length audio into a small fixed number of vectors before the LLM, plus a lightweight 'tuning' stage to unlock cross-modal emergent ability.
notes: CVPR 2024 (confirmed via crossref). CAUTION on citation: arXiv admin flagged video-SALMONN (2406.15704) for substantial text overlap with 2310.05863, so treat 2310.13289 and the video-SALMONN line as one research cluster rather than independent corroboration. The resampler is the inference-relevant mechanism: compressing audio to a fixed token count decouples LLM prefill cost from audio duration, which is the same lever the VLM projectors pull on the vision side.
